'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Paul Bonsall DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bonsall]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
